it is a CODE gate (tools._is_opal_user) and cannot be expressed in IAM, because the principal is a gateway-level identity and not an AWS one. After this act IAM admits the served surface to the role the gateway assumes, so a regression in that predicate would not be caught by IAM. Named plainly in the never-widen ask; what holds it is test_oghv1_ac02/ac04 plus AC2's live negative arms.
